_note: All companies and plants are fictional. {d1}..{d7} = the 7 days of the ledger week. {H} = floor of the true hour-by-hour share for the gold claim, {V} = floor of the true certificate-volume share; +N adds N points. Gold fields are what a careful human would extract; the verdict is computed by src/checker.mjs from the gold fields, never written by hand.
